name: GRIT DOUBLE
author: Niklas Wallin
shortDesc: Tight doubler with grit — thickens a single-coil lead
desc: A close doubler that adds body and edge to a lead vocal over electric guitar. Dialled in with a single-coil guitar (Strat or Tele) direct into the device, medium input gain. The subtle pitch variation gives it a tape-doubled character rather than a clinical copy. Works well for rock, blues and rootsy styles where a big, live vocal sound matters more than pristine accuracy. Bring the Mix knob down slightly if the doubling effect is too obvious in your room.
